gloss: far away; distant place; way beyond

definitions.gloss: far away; a very distant place; way beyond (in space or time)
definitions.explanation: An extremely distant location or point, either in physical space or metaphorically in time. Combines two words for distance, creating an intensified expression that evokes vast, poetic distance. Common in literary and dramatic language.

examples.japanese: {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}に{山|やま}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: Mountains are visible far in the distance.

examples.japanese: {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}の{故郷|ふるさと}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}の{記憶|きおく}は{遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}に{霞|かす}んでいる。
examples.english: Memories of childhood have faded into the distant past.

notes:
Combines {遥|はる}か (far, distant) and {彼方|かなた} (yonder, over there, the other side). Both words individually mean "far" or "distant," and together they create a poetically intensified expression of great distance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}に{見|み}える: to be visible far in the distance
- {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}の{空|そら}: the distant sky
- {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}の{昔|むかし}: the distant past
- {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}へ{消|き}える: to vanish into the distance

USAGE:
A literary and somewhat poetic expression. Common in novels, songs, anime/manga titles, and dramatic narration. Evokes a sense of longing, nostalgia, or grandeur. Can refer to physical distance (a faraway mountain) or temporal distance (a distant memory). In everyday conversation, people would more likely use {遠|とお}い or {遥|はる}か alone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {遥|はる}か: far, distant — less dramatic than {遥|はる}か{彼方|かなた}
- {彼方|かなた}: yonder, the other side — indicates the far side, without the intensifying force of {遥|はる}か
- {遠|とお}く: far away — the everyday word for distance, less poetic
